examples: Speak slowly.
He spoke to me.
The baby cannot speak yet.

more.def: To say words out loud, or to be able to use a language.
examples: Please speak clearly so the whole class can hear you.
My neighbor speaks three languages.
The principal spoke to the school about the field trip.
Today is a special day.
Grandma made a special cake.
You are special to me.

more.def: Better, different or more important than usual.
examples: We eat a special meal on the last day of school.
The museum has a special show about space.
The toy was special because my grandpa made it.
Firefighters wear special coats.
The cat has a special bed.
This special paper is for painting.

more.def: Made or meant for one particular use or person.
examples: Astronauts wear special suits in space.
The shop sells special shoes for running.
The bus has a special seat for people who need help.

easy.def: To use money to buy things.
examples: I spend my coins on stickers.
I spent a dollar on a toy.
He spent his allowance on a book.
She spent all her birthday money on art supplies.
Families spend a lot on food each week.
The town spent money fixing the old bridge.
We spent the day at the beach.
She spends time with her dog.
I spend my mornings at school.

more.def: To pass time doing something or being somewhere.
examples: We spent the whole summer at my grandparents' farm.
He spends an hour each night reading.
The owl spends the daytime sleeping in a hollow tree.
